_readme: Which files in this repository are the PRODUCT (pad-kit), which are the ENGINE (the store
and the pipeline loop, owned by whoever owns the live data), and which are this INSTANCE's
own (config, env, data). The drift check reads this file to tell an instance-local hack
apart from a legitimate instance difference.
Rule of the split: a diff in a PRODUCT file inside an instance tree is a hack that has to
go upstream as a PR, or move into config. ENGINE files may diverge while the two engines
coexist, but the divergence is listed every run so it can never be forgotten. INSTANCE
Change the pin deliberately: edit product.ref, then run the check.
